[SWS_UCM_00263] Update preparation failure
⌈
If any one of the State Management UpdateRequest Service Interface Prepare-
Update method returns error kFailed, UCM shall transition from kActivating to
kPreparing states and report FAILED to the UCM_PREPAREUPDATE_FAILED. When
the update preparation of the update succeeds, a PASSED shall be reported alterna-
tively.
⌋
